transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because... for nearly two years now, I've been sure that the contractor and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us. They just keep my kitchen half-wrong on purpose. And it doesn't matter how many receipts my husband shows me, or how many excuses they give... I know what they're doing.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or seen things that other people couldn't see or hear?
No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or... or see things that aren't there. My mind is perfectly sound, doctor. I just see what's actually happening right in front of me with the house.
Over these past two years, have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or unable to enjoy your usual activities?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... it's incredibly frustrating dealing with all this nonsense with the house, of course. It makes me angry. But I'm not depressed. I still go about my day and enjoy my regular routine just fine, as long as I don't have to deal with those people.
Have you ever had any major medical problems or neurological conditions?
No, I haven't. I've always been pretty healthy, honestly. No major medical issues or... or brain problems or anything like that. Just the usual aches and pains of getting older, but nothing serious.
Before this issue with the contractor started two years ago, did you tend to be suspicious of people's motives throughout your life?

No, not at all. I mean... I've always gotten along with people just fine. I never went around suspecting people of things or... or doubting their motives before this whole mess started. I just took people at their word, mostly. It's really just this specific situation with the contractor, because of what they're actually doing to my home. Before that, I was never a suspicious person.
